Solara — (9.0) THE ONE

DISORDER AND CHAOS

"Disorder and chaos"

[Verse 1]

I called them back before the morning

The garden held a different kind of cold

Something pressing at the edges

Something that the night before had not been bold

Themis arrived first — she already knew

Nemesis came second with her ledger held in both hands

Time and Fate sat close together

The way they do when something neither understands

[Pre-Chorus]

And I told them what I felt

At the edge of what I see

Something that was distant in the dark

Is learning how to breathe

Not a flicker anymore

Not a signal

Not a presence barely born

Something building in the space between the order

Something choosing to be more

[Chorus]

Disorder and chaos

Coming into form

The Hollow is not what they described

It is something that outgrew the warning

Disorder and chaos

Older than it should be

The one before me sealed the last one

But this time

Something got to it before me

Three hundred thousand years of holding past the ending

Fed it

While the twins were trying to converge

And now the Hollow has the weight of all that waiting

And I have just arrived

And that is what we’re up against

[Verse 2]

Nemesis opens her ledger

Lays it flat

Three hundred thousand years

Of energy the order held intact

Every year he stayed past the convergence

Fed the other side the same

He sealed the last one yes

But sealing is not ending

And what he sealed

Did not stay tame

Aion reads the long view

He goes pale

Kairos says: the timing was already compromised

Before I arrived

And Ananke —

Ananke doesn’t speak

She closes her eyes

And I understand

That even necessity

Has something it cannot guarantee

[Pre-Chorus 2]

And Time takes my hand again

But this time differently

Not the pride of the arrival

The fear that I might see

What he has always seen

What the one before me carried

Beyond all that we know

Three hundred thousand years of sealing something

That kept deciding

It could grow

[Chorus]

Disorder and chaos

Coming into form

The Hollow is not what they described

It is something that outgrew the warning

Disorder and chaos

Older than it should be

The one before me sealed the last one

But this time

Something got to it before me

[Bridge — SOLARA addresses the council directly]

Here is what he did not tell me

Here is what the hand did not give

He sealed the last Hollow

When it was young

Before it learned to live

This one had three hundred thousand extra years

To find its edges

To find its shape

To find the difference between

Being sealed

And being contained

And being free

He stayed too long

And I do not blame him

He was afraid to leave

And something used that fear

As food

And now I am here

Younger than he was at his first crisis

Facing something that is older and has fed

And I am going to have to do

What he could not

Not seal it

End it.

[Final Chorus — SOLARA standing, certain]

Disorder and chaos

That is what it is

But disorder has a pattern

If you learn to read the fizz

Disorder and chaos

Built on borrowed time

Three hundred thousand years of someone else’s ending

Is still three hundred thousand years

And that much weight

Always leaves a line

I am not the one who sealed the last one

I am the one who ended what he feared

I did not seal the twins’ convergence

I arrived because someone finally cleared

And I will not seal this either

[Outro — the council sits. Planning begins.]

The garden is cold.

The Raven is awake.

Themis opens a new page.

Nemesis recalculates.

Time and Fate hold hands and do not speak.

SOLARA looks at the sky

Where the Hollow is growing

And she does not look away.

This is the new order’s first crisis.

And she was built for this.
